items.title: 1. Belt is a thin hoop standing off the belly
items.evidence: 1_beauty hero/az000: wide tan band hugs the belly with no light gap, toggle visible front-centre; az090 reads as a strap on the hip; techqa hit 0 float 0.

items.title: 2. Moss is one flat olive cap; rocks are pebbles
items.evidence: Moss is now brighter green and rocks are larger and on the shoulder caps (1_beauty back34, az000), but 5_reference top pair still shows a smooth green sheet with no hide down the centre and only mild lumps, not clear 0.3-0.4 m clumps.

items.title: 3. Loincloth flaps are paper-thin rods in profile
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000/hero front flap is wider and fuller, but az090 still shows both flaps as thin brown sticks standing off the body.

items.title: 4. Belly and pec shelf are flat
items.evidence: 2_closeups front limb wire/colour shows a rounded belly under the pecs, but 1_beauty az090 silhouette is still nearly straight chest to knee with only a small bulge at the belt, far from the reference's 0.25 m.

items.title: 5. Toes are nubs
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000 and 2_closeups hind limb: toes are still small blocks under the foot wedge, nowhere near the reference's big rounded toes.
